title: Smart Data Models - Apiary
description: A site where a group of beehives is kept, with its official registration, capacity and the forage available around it

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Apiary

legalId.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Official registration code of the apiary in the national livestock registry

hiveCapacity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Maximum number of hives the apiary is authorised or equipped to hold

isMigratory.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the hives of this apiary are moved seasonally to follow the blooming (transhumance)

items.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Scientific name of a forage plant species

forageSpecies.description: Property. Main plant species available for foraging around the apiary

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. Reference to the AgriParcel where the apiary is located
